purpose: Teach: 士郎/一太郎/大竹/せりふ/ぶた/オトコ/メンズ/いっか

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「Fateの士郎は正義の味方」って教えて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad was telling me that Fate's Shiro is a true hero of justice.
lines.style: Warm, slightly dreamy tone. Gentle smile in the voice. Sharing something precious she heard, as if turning it over in her mind. Soft delivery, no rush.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと一太郎で読書感想文を書いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I wrote a book report with Dad using Ichitaro today!
lines.style: Bright, eager rush of words tumbling out. Small boy pride in accomplishment. Slight breathlessness—wanting her to understand how special this was. Open, guileless.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「大竹一樹の漫才は古典」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad was saying that Otake and Kaz's comedy routines are classics.
lines.style: Same gentle reflectiveness as before. Turning the observation over. A small laugh underneath—appreciating her father's quirky perspective. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと舞台のせりふを練習したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I practiced stage lines together today!
lines.style: Excited, eager delivery. Small voice but carrying big happiness. Words come quick. That innocent pride of a child sharing something ordinary that felt extraordinary.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが動物園で「ぶたさんは賢い」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad said something about pigs being really smart when we were at the zoo.
lines.style: Softly amused. Gentle tone, like she's remembering something small and dear. A slight smile. Not performing the reflection—just naturally dwelling in it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「真のオトコは優しさを持つ」って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad taught me that a real man is someone who has kindness.
lines.style: Quieter now, more serious underneath the eagerness. The words matter—he said something important and it landed. Slightly slower, more weight on each word. Still a child's voice, but one who understood something.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがメンズ専門店で帽子を選ばれたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad picked out a hat for himself at the men's shop.
lines.style: Gentle, observant. A small moment of everyday life delivered with affection. Quiet pleasure in noticing something about him. No drama—just warmth.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「もういっか、また明日ね」って優しく言われたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad said to me so softly, "That's okay, let's try again tomorrow."
lines.style: Voice becomes very small and tender. Quoting his gentleness back to her. Slow, almost fragile. The memory of being held by his kindness. Trailing off slightly—precious and vulnerable.
